title: Control Plane Closed Loop Candidate Decision

decisions.reason: Provider smoke failures need an owned claim/verifier decision before becoming durable closed loops.
Load harness client-read pressure failures need a claim-bound verifier before they become recurring performance gates.
Load harness promotion failures must not remain isolated workflow reports without a decision owner.
Control-plane hot-path benchmark failures need an owned adoption decision before becoming closed-loop gates.
Control-plane performance promotion failures must stay connected to candidate intake and decision ownership.
The v3 thread history endpoint is a measured local pressure hotspot and needs a claim-bound optimization decision before it becomes a recurring gate.
HTTP metrics observe is already low allocation, so keep evidence instead of adopting an optimization gate immediately.
Store metrics observe is already low allocation, so keep evidence instead of adopting an optimization gate immediately.
Fine-grained provider progress remains a measured allocation hotspot and needs a claim-bound batching or retention verifier decision.
Thread stream subscription targets are measured but currently low allocation, so keep trend evidence before adding a new gate.
Client event subscriber fanout is a measured allocation and CPU hotspot and needs an owned claim-bound optimization decision.
Thread history v3 projection is a measured refresh pressure surface and needs a claim-bound projection/copy-cost decision.
Assignment long-poll waiters are now directly measured with bounded goroutine delta, so keep trend evidence before adopting a new optimization gate.
Tool approval waiters are now directly measured with bounded goroutine delta, so keep redacted pressure evidence before expanding approval UX gates.
Loop closure audit is an intake source even when current residual and claim coverage gaps are closed, so it keeps a seed decision for source coverage.

assertions: every candidate consumed by intake must have exactly one decision record
decision records for the consumed candidate source without a matching candidate are stale loop residue and must fail verification
decision records must name owner, priority, disposition, next loop, and next artifact
decision next_artifact must be one of the required_next_artifacts declared by the consumed candidate artifact
decision verification must reject candidates whose adoption_plan does not cover every required_next_artifact
decision evidence must expose the executable command selected from the consumed candidate adoption_plan
decision evidence must expose owner, priority, disposition, and review_by next to the selected executable command
decision evidence must expose the consumed candidate promotion_edge for the selected next artifact
decision verification must reject candidates whose source_ref drifts from the consumed candidate artifact envelope
candidate decision evidence must expose candidate_source_refs for every consumed candidate item
triage-required or deferred candidates must name a non-expired review_by date
triage-required candidates must stay redacted and carry enough context for a follow-up claim binding
candidate decision verification must run on a schedule so decision ownership does not rely on memory
candidate decision verification must fail when no candidate artifact is supplied
scheduled candidate decision must download live candidate artifacts from every intake source and verify non-empty candidate sets against decision records
candidate decision workflow path triggers must include linked intake, producer, and loop registry manifests
candidate decision fixture promotion must pin the harness promotion clock so deterministic samples do not fail after real-time expiry
candidate decision must reject consumed candidate artifacts unless source_generated_at < source_expires_at and now < source_expires_at
candidate decision evidence must publish generated_at and expires_at
candidate decision evidence must expose consumed candidate artifact path, source workflow, freshness window, and candidate ids
candidate decision records must include at least one owned seed decision for every intake source so new harness sources cannot be passive
candidate decision workflow path triggers must include every producer source workflow from intake
candidate decision PR verification must consume a performance-specific candidate fixture
candidate decision PR verification must publish explicit skipped evidence when a sampled candidate artifact has zero open candidates

loop.observation: Candidate intake can prove adoption requirements, but candidates can still wait for an implicit human priority decision.
loop.hypothesis: A candidate decision sidecar can force every redacted candidate to bind owner, priority, disposition, next loop, next artifact, and review expiry.
loop.execute: Generate this reader from the decision manifest, generate deterministic candidate fixtures, verify intake, verify candidate decisions with explicit candidate artifacts, publish skipped evidence for sampled artifacts with zero candidates, download latest live candidate artifacts on non-PR runs, verify non-empty live candidate sets, and publish decision evidence in CI.
loop.evaluate: The verifier fails on missing candidate input, missing candidate decisions, orphan decision records, duplicate decisions, unknown dispositions, missing owners, invalid priorities, expired review dates, expired or exact-expiry candidate artifacts, stale docs, missing live artifact download wiring, missing scheduled workflow evidence, missing sampled skip evidence, or unredacted candidate content.
loop.retrospective: This moves prioritization metadata into executable knowledge: humans can still choose implementation order, but candidates cannot exist without an owned disposition and review deadline.
